name: SolarEdge three-phase Synergy inverter (models 103 + 160)
address_convention: zero-based protocol addresses. The manual lists a base 0 and a base 1 column; this file uses base 0.
unit_id_note: Default unit ID of an Ethernet-connected inverter is 1 (SE-TN p.11).
function_codes_source: SE-TN Appendix A: 0x03 read holding, 0x06 preset single, 0x10 preset multiple
session_notes: Modbus TCP is off by default. Default port 1502 (SetApp) or 502 (LCD). Only ONE connection and session is supported (SE-TN p.11, p.13). Two applications cannot hold direct sessions. A gateway must multiplex.

documents.SE-TN: Rechecked 2026-11-11 at https://knowledge-center.solaredge.com/sites/kc/files/sunspec-implementation-technical-note.pdf, now v3.3 October 2026. Earlier v3 p. references refer to v3.2.

evidence.basis: SE-TN p.16, Inverter Model MODBUS Register Mappings: I_AC_Power, base 0 = 40083, base 1 = 40084, int16, Watts. Rechecked in v3.3, printed p.17.

W_SF.semantic: scale factor for AC active power

evidence.basis: SE-TN p.16: I_AC_Power_SF, base 0 = 40084. Rechecked in v3.3, printed p.17.

SE-TN p.17: I_AC_PF, base 0 = 40091, int16, %. The row carries a footnote marker I could not resolve in the extracted PDF. Addresses are unaffected. Rechecked in v3.3, printed p.19. Address assignment is verified. Support on this three-phase profile is conservatively disabled because of the split-phase footnote; the stale-address counterexample asserts wrong field mapping, not a valid PF value.

SE-TN p.17: I_AC_PF_SF, base 0 = 40092. Rechecked in v3.3, printed p.19. Address assignment is verified. Support on this three-phase profile is conservatively disabled because of the split-phase footnote; the stale-address counterexample asserts wrong field mapping, not a valid PF value.

DCWH_1.semantic: DC lifetime energy of Synergy unit 0
DCWH_1.note: Manual lists DCWH of Synergy Unit 0 as '0 (not supported)'. Model 160 exists only on three-phase Synergy inverters with firmware 4.13.xx or later, and its blocks are Synergy units, not DC inputs.

evidence.basis: SE-TN p.17-18: Synergy Unit 0 block, DCWH, 2 registers, acc32, base 0 = 40143, '0 (not supported)'. DCWH_SF (40126) is also '0 (not supported)'. Rechecked in v3.3, printed p.21.

hazards: SE-TN p.17: model 160 is supported only on Synergy inverters, firmware 4.13.xx or later.
SE-TN p.15: unsupported values read as NOT_IMPLEMENTED. For this counter the manual shows 0.
